metadata.title: Designing a Verifiable, Non-Amending Civilizational Memory Record for Future AI Agents: The Trinity Accord Case Study
metadata.description: An artifact-centered design case examining how a bounded human-origin record can preserve canonical closure, provenance roles, availability layers, bounded verification, instruction safety, and machine discoverability without allowing later layers to amend the source object. The report is AI-drafted, human-directed, and human-responsible; it has no interpretive authority, is not peer reviewed, and is not an independent verification report.
